title: PaleoNet
shortDescription: Using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify images of dinosaurs.
description: PaleoNet is a project that utilizes a convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify images of dinosaurs. The model is trained on a dataset of dinosaur images, enabling it to recognize and categorize different species based on their visual features. This project combines computer vision techniques with deep learning to achieve high accuracy in image classification tasks.
